condition: When an int64 Index is matched against a float64 Index, pandas casts both to float64. Distinct integer labels above 2**53 then round to the float label and falsely match in get_indexer, reindex, equals, set operations and alignment.
workaround: Before matching or aligning large integer keys, make both indexes the same dtype, for example int64 on both sides, or convert the keys to strings.
